gc.futterfolge.title: Feeding order (Mod)
gc.futterfolge.short: GC mod: tamed animals spot food further away, and the animal with the highest level eats first.
gc.futterfolge.body:
The mod makes sure that when food is scarce the best animals get fed and mate ([[gc.futterfolge.enabled]]). With [[gc.tiere|GC_Tiere]] the [[gc.tiere.breedlevel|breeding level]] counts, otherwise Valheim's stars; with GC_Tiere the [[gc.futterfolge.partner|best mate]] also counts for breeding.

All values except the rank display are [[gc.serverrules|server rules]]. [[gc.kern.stufe|Level]] 4 “GC light”; while on, the mod adds 1 % per boss to the [[gc.kern.bossscale|boss progression]].

gc.futterfolge.enabled.title: Feeding order
gc.futterfolge.enabled.short: Tamed animals spot food {gc_futterfolge_range} as far as in Valheim if a path leads there; the highest level eats first.

gc.futterfolge.partner.title: Best mate
gc.futterfolge.partner.short: With GC_Tiere, the young's level uses the best fed mate at conception. Currently {gc_futterfolge_partner}.
gc.futterfolge.partner.body: When an animal becomes pregnant, it remembers the highest [[gc.tiere.breedlevel|breeding level]] among the fed mates of its kind within mating range, instead of taking the nearest animal at birth. From that and its own level GC_Tiere rolls the young's level. The hint on the pregnant animal shows “Mate: Lvl X”. Without GC_Tiere there are no breeding levels, and the setting is not shown.

gc.futterfolge.rank.title: Show feeding rank
gc.futterfolge.rank.short: Shows on a hungry tamed animal where it stands in the feeding order; your own setting, currently {gc_futterfolge_rank}.
gc.futterfolge.rank.body: The hint reads like “Feeding rank 2 of 5”, plus “Letting higher-ranked animals eat first” while the animal waits. This setting only applies to you, not to the server. The order itself: [[gc.futterfolge.enabled]].
